title: 烬·白面长廊
description: 烬穿完整象牙与酒红戏服静立长廊，白色不对称面具与单眼轮廓突出，枪械安全闭合收存于身侧。

art_direction.medium: angular wax-crayon strokes, directional hatching and dramatic hard-edged light on textured paper
art_direction.identity: Jhin is a slender adult masked performer with a smooth asymmetrical white theatrical mask, one dark eye opening, flowing cream cloth, burgundy accents, and refined armored costume panels. Preserve his tall elegant adult silhouette with fully covering sleeves, gloves, opaque trousers, and boots. His ornate firearm remains secured in a closed fitted side case, never held, aimed, or presented toward the viewer.
art_direction.scene: Show him standing in an empty monumental theater corridor, one gloved hand resting near the opposite wrist and the head turned slightly toward a distant open arch. The closed weapon case is a minor side detail. Hard directional light strikes the white mask and breaks cream cloth into angular wax-crayon planes, with deep burgundy shadows and spare perspective instead of ominous stage effects.
art_direction.palette: mask ivory, burgundy, charcoal, restrained pale gold
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: up to ten images on a compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280
